Electricity Department Govt. of Pondicherry, Pondicherry-605 001. **....Respondents** # ** ORDER ** The petitioner **,** Power Grid Corporation of India Limited, has filed the present petition seeking provisional tariff on the expenditure incurred by PGCIL **Order in Petition No. 120/MP/2014** **2** on construction of Mysore (Power Grid)-Kozhikode (Power Grid) 400 kV D/C line along with 400/220 kV Kozhikode sub-station (New) and extension of Mysore sub-station under transmission system and advise to State Administration to provide necessary protection /security and assistance for laying the transmission line. 2. The petitioner vide its letter dated 21.2.1017 has submitted that the disputes involved in the petition have been resolved and the project has been completed. The petitioner has further submitted that since, the Commission vide order dated 30.5.2016 in Petition No. 276/TT/2015 has already approved the tariff for the subject transmission system, the present petition has become infructuous. The petitioner has sought permission to withdraw the present petition. 3. The prayer of the petitioner is allowed. Accordingly, Petition No. 120/MP/2014 is disposed of as withdrawn.
